attchmntText: Master Trust Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 16, 2026, titled "Submission of Press Release regarding  mastertrust Introduces mtAlgoZ  ".
voiceSummary: Master Trust Limited submitted a press release to BSE and NSE on 16th November 2026 regarding the launch of mtAlgoZ. This is a web-based platform for building, testing, and managing automated trading strategies using a no-code interface. The platform features zero brokerage, zero subscription charges, and zero platform fees. It includes white-box algo strategies, options strategies, and TradingView webhook connectivity. Execution occurs on broker servers with internet-independent capabilities. Risk controls are available at both portfolio and strategy levels. The company aims to expand its digital product ecosystem and enhance accessibility for digitally active market participants. Mr. Puneet Singhania, Whole Time Director of Master Capital Services Limited, commented on the launch as a milestone in building a technology-driven financial services ecosystem.

attchmntText: Master Trust Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "PRESS RELEASE FOR RAISING OF 75 CR FUND BY WHOLLY OWNED SUBSIDIARY COMPANY I.E. MASTER CAPITAL SERVICES LIMITED THROUGH ALLOTMENT OF 75000 NCDs AT AN ISSUE PRICE OF RS. 10,000/- PER DEBENTURES ".
voiceSummary: Master Trust Limited intimates that its wholly owned subsidiary, Master Capital Services Limited, has raised Rs. 75 crores through the allotment of 75,000 Non-Convertible Debentures. The issuance was approved in the Legal, Banking and Finance Committee meeting held on 12th November, 2026. Each debenture has a face value of Rs. 10,000 and carries a coupon rate of 10.50%. The securities are secured, listed, rated, redeemable, and non-convertible. The maturity date is 12th May, 2028. The ISIN for the instrument is INE2UHF07023. The funds are intended for general corporate purposes and to meet working capital requirements. This information is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
